agencyName: Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals & Licensing (DIAL), Electrical Examining Board
authorityRationale: The Electrical Examining Board's own licensing hub page under Iowa DIAL, identifying the board and its contact information, and linking every official form used by applicants (fee schedule, continuing-education forms, and the reciprocal-agreements PDF). reliabilityRationale: Official board page, actively maintained (references the 2026 renewal cycle beginning October 2025); used here for board identity and as the entry point that links to the reciprocity PDF and admin-code chapters cited elsewhere.
